modelling.house: Thick hollow shell, real architectural openings, inset glass, separate mullions, individual planks on DoorHinge, closed sculpted roof petals and bud.
modelling.flowers: Each petal is a closed curved mesh, trumpet has inner and outer walls, stems are tubes.
modelling.leaves: Closed curved lanceolate meshes with raised midribs, distributed in three dimensions.
modelling.terrain: 3D heightfields with a sandy path, volumetric distant hills and cloud volumes.

optimization: glTF Transform 4.5.1 prune + dedup; no runtime codecs
